families.title: Photo-frame master

families.title: Fit vs animation engine

families.title: Photo cache
families.behavior: Cache row exists only for Immich or WebDAV; the parent photo-frame switch must also be on. Folder, built-in, album, SMB and web sources hide it.
families.evidence: Source + 14 browser combinations; remote-source hardware states require configuration

families.title: Overnight
families.behavior: Reveals Off from, Off until and dim night clock. Current times are retained on disable.
families.evidence: Portal parent toggled and restored

families.title: Sleep preferences
families.behavior: Reveals duration, pause-audio and close-app rows on the frame page.
families.evidence: Portal parent toggled and restored

families.title: Sleep standalone
families.behavior: Duration hides when disabled; pause-audio and close-app stay editable. Start has no effect while disabled. Stop resets countdown.
families.evidence: Portal baseline + source + browser transitions; no countdown armed on device

families.title: Ambient audio
families.behavior: Volume appears for any sound other than Off, while the frame parent is enabled.
families.evidence: Source + seven browser states

families.title: Calendar
families.behavior: No link: no widget switch. Link with switch off: no range/size/side. Link with switch on: all three children.
families.evidence: Portal no-link editor; valid webcal and invalid web drafts inspected and cancelled; source + browser truth table; no feed saved

families.title: Digital clock
families.behavior: Reveals face, size, position, background, date and seconds. Retired style/color/font/glow are never editor rows.
families.evidence: Portal parent toggled and restored

families.title: Photo clock face
families.behavior: Face choice hides while disabled. Size exists only for Flip, Big and Bold, and only with the face enabled. Preview remains available.
families.evidence: Disabled state and Flip/Big/Bold/Minimal inspected on Portal; original Immortal face and enabled state restored; browser truth table

families.title: Chime actions
families.behavior: Voice picker and Test voice only with Spoken time; Play chime only with Hourly; sunrise/sunset tests and sunrise variant only with Golden hour; Ping when any is on.
families.evidence: All eight combinations physically inspected; parents restored

families.title: Quiet hours
families.behavior: Start/end times hide when quiet hours are off. Volume remains visible even with all three sound parents off.
families.evidence: Portal parent roundtrip + source + browser truth table

families.title: Welcome
families.behavior: Voice and greeting editors, timing, size and opacity stay editable with all display/TTS switches off. Installed offline voices are enumerated dynamically.
families.evidence: Portal slow-scroll through full content; 42 observed offline voice labels plus Default represented

families.title: Sunrise
families.behavior: Native hour/minute/days/ramp/chime editors stay visible while off. The remote registry gates scalar editors. Next trigger depends on enabled/time/selected days.
families.evidence: Portal baseline and parent roundtrip + source + browser checks

families.title: MQTT
families.behavior: Enabled reveals host/port/user/password/TLS. TLS converts only default port 1883↔8883; custom port stays. Certificate validation is retained, hidden.
families.evidence: Portal parent roundtrip + source + browser TLS checks; no broker configured

families.title: Multi-room
families.behavior: Enabled reveals server/IP, API port, username, password and authentication action/status. Setup guidance remains visible.
families.evidence: Portal parent roundtrip + source + browser; no audio server configured

families.title: Quick buttons
families.behavior: Always show appears only while app-switcher button is enabled.
families.evidence: Portal parent toggled and restored

families.title: Countdown year
families.behavior: Repeats yearly hides Year; month/day/icon/name remain. Empty/nonempty collections and validation are mapped.
families.evidence: Portal editor inspected + source + browser truth table

families.title: Dismissal target
families.behavior: HA option requires its companion app. HA mode reveals dashboard path. Launcher/app selection persists the destination; installed-app list has loading/loaded states.
families.evidence: Installed HA confirmed; native picker inspected; source + browser path tests

families.title: HA discovery
families.parent: connection result + query + group expansion + pinned state
families.behavior: Search by name or entity id; search forces groups open and uncaps rows; browsing caps at 12. Picker supports 13 domains; dashboard has its own tile model. No-match, zero-entity, offline and pinned duplicates are separate states.
families.evidence: Existing connection discovered 1004 entities through native UI with fields untouched. Expanded Lights verified 12 visible plus 74 remaining. Public group counts retained, private entity names/IDs omitted. Source + browser fixtures cover empty/error/search/pinning branches

families.title: URL editors
families.behavior: Album: iCloud/Google/Synology recognition. Calendar: http/https/webcal + ICS or recognized provider. Web: literal http/https prefix. Blank/invalid Save disabled. Only existing calendar exposes Remove. Cancel keeps saved value.
families.evidence: Native forms and calendar draft validation inspected; drafts cancelled; source + valid/invalid browser fixtures

families.title: Connection forms
families.behavior: Immich transitions to whole-library/album selection. SMB/DAV need nonempty photo results; empty/offline/auth errors retain the previous source. Cancellation ignores late completion.
families.evidence: Native forms inspected; source + browser fixture branches; successful server replies are not hardware proof

families.title: Folder browser
families.behavior: Permission denied, roots, no roots, subfolders, Up, no subfolders, scan/count/loading, images/videos, zero media and capped totals. Use requires an actual folder.
families.evidence: Native picker inspected; personal folder names/media omitted; source + browser fixtures

families.title: Health
families.parent: five permission checks + active device admin
families.behavior: Healthy vs issues; each missing permission explains impact/fix. Disable action exists only with active admin and needs two deliberate steps. Connected debug app currently lacks screen-off permission.
families.evidence: Portal observed missing screen-off; no permission/admin changes

families.title: Boot / world clock
families.behavior: Boot list: loading, empty, all launchable packages. World clock: 13 cities; first four selected visible, others selected/hidden; ordering preserved.
families.evidence: Portal full lists + source + browser selection/order checks

families.title: Collection editors
families.behavior: Crypto, to-do, RSS, stocks and options have empty/list/add/remove states. Clear completed exists only with completed to-dos. Crypto symbol is optional and falls back to uppercase coin id; ticker symbols normalize uppercase. Stocks/options share Alpaca credentials.
families.evidence: Native configured Crypto editor inspected without editing selections. Unconfigured optional editors mapped from source and browser fixtures.

families.title: Alarm editor
families.behavior: Time/day editors remain visible while disabled. Hour wraps 0–23; minute stepping wraps by five. No selected days means a one-time alarm; Snooze uses nine minutes.
families.evidence: Native Home widget and Tools editors inspected without arming or changing an alarm; ring/snooze states use fixtures.

families.title: Camera forms
families.parent: empty/nonempty list + add form + URL validation + stream result
families.behavior: Empty camera list opens the add form. Saved cameras offer view/remove and add. Name is optional, defaults to Camera; literal rtsp:// and more than eight characters required. Stream/failure/removal states are mapped.
families.evidence: Native camera entry/add form inspected without opening private streams or saving/removing cameras; playback results use fixtures.

families.title: Notes / timers / converter
families.parent: memo present + recording + timers active + converter category
families.behavior: Notes expose recording, stop, playback and deletion based on memo state. Timers expose active countdown/cancel rows. Converter categories replace the unit lists.
families.evidence: Native Tools screens inspected without saving notes, recording/broadcasting audio or scheduling timers; browser fixtures cover state transitions.

families.title: Lamp controls
families.behavior: Night light hides Warmth but retains Brightness. Hiding controls removes the panel. Sleep uses the existing screen-off action; there is no separate native lamp sleep-timer picker. Window brightness override ends on exit.
families.evidence: Native normal/red modes inspected and restored; source + browser visibility checks.

families.title: Settings search
families.behavior: Search can locate hidden settings without changing preferences. It explains missing prerequisites and links to the parent editor. Only the explicit review harness expands fixture parents.
families.source: Mock search flow; native implementation requirement
families.evidence: Browser verifies hidden-setting guidance leaves Night Shift off and never manufactures a calendar feed.

families.title: Platform-owned UI
families.behavior: Android, stock Portal, Browser, Calls, YouTube Music and installed apps retain their owners’ screens, permissions and dialogs. The redesign controls the Immortal entry points.
families.evidence: Eleven firmware entry pages inspected over USB; resolution results recorded separately. Existing platform-owned UI remains the actual destination, including its submenus.

families.title: Automatic / hardware exclusions
families.behavior: Eight intentionally hidden specs and legacy persisted fields retained. Portal+ has no battery, so battery saver remains unavailable.
families.evidence: Source + public hardware evidence + browser reachability checks

limitations: Existing Home Assistant discovery was verified on the device. Unconfigured Immich, SMB and WebDAV server replies use source-mapped fixtures; no connection was replaced to manufacture a hardware test.
Intentional destructive paths (install, uninstall, admin removal, credential replacement, physical HA actuation) were mapped without executing them.
Installed version and source commit alone do not prove identical APK bytes. Native visual parity requires the approved implementation and screenshot comparison.

The installed Speed test tile did not expose its metric pane during USB checks. Its source-defined metric/progress/retry UI is mapped in the mock; native opening must be verified during implementation.
